viewing_check: Unroll fully. Check the back for knot density and the weave (hand-knotted vs machine), pile wear and low spots, moth damage, fringe and edge condition, stains or pet odour, colour run in the red, and any repairs. Photograph the back and a close-up of the pile. Check the actual size and any label.
